hero.h1: Kitchen Remodeling in Ithaca, NY, With the Price Fixed Before We Build
hero.subheadline: Upscale Remodeling designs and builds kitchens, baths, basements and additions under one roof. You get running estimates during design and a fixed price before construction, backed by a 5-year warranty.

image.alt: Kitchen remodeling Ithaca NY: home addition kitchen with warm wood cabinets, stainless double wall ovens and a sliding door to the yard

intro.h2: Know the number before the walls come down
paragraphs: Upscale Remodeling has handled kitchen remodeling in Ithaca, NY since 1991 as a full-service design-build firm. The same team draws your kitchen and builds it, so the design is priced against real construction costs as it develops.

The firm is open about money. Its pricing page says most Ithaca-area kitchens it completes start at $70,000 and most bathrooms at $40,000. During design you get running estimates, and before construction starts you get a fixed price. Older Ithaca homes bring plaster walls, aging plumbing and knob-and-tube wiring, so those are checked early, before design decisions are locked in.

services.h2: What the Upscale team designs and builds

items.name: Kitchen Remodeling
items.blurb: Custom cabinets, quartz and natural stone counters, fixtures, lighting and storage, chosen in the private Design Studio in Freeville. Projects range from updating a dated layout to opening walls into the dining room. Most kitchens are finished in 8 to 14 weeks from the start of construction.

image.alt: Remodeled kitchen with brown leather stools around a marble-topped island with reclaimed wood paneling and white cabinets

items.name: Bathroom Remodeling
items.blurb: Primary baths, hall baths and half baths, from a leaking tub replaced with new tile, tub, counter and trim to a full redesign with custom vanities. Christie, a Certified Kitchen & Bath Designer, leads design, and most Ithaca-area bathrooms the firm completes start at $40,000.

image.alt: Remodeled bathroom in an Ithaca, NY home with a warm wood vanity, lighted mirror cabinet and built-in linen storage

items.name: Basement Renovation and Finishing
items.blurb: Unfinished basements turned into usable rooms, from entertainment spaces to wet bars, designed and built by the same team as the rest of your house. Work like this in the Finger Lakes region starts with a look at what is behind the walls and under the floor.

image.alt: Finished basement in the Finger Lakes region with a dark-cabinet wet bar, bottle shelves and a pub-height table

items.name: Additions and Renovations
items.blurb: Sunrooms, three-season rooms, mudrooms and kitchen additions that fit the house you already have. One South Ithaca project paired an addition with a renovation, and a Cayuga Heights home gained a three-season room. All permits, inspections and subcontractor coordination are handled directly.

image.alt: Three-season room addition on a stone house in the Cayuga Heights neighborhood of Ithaca, NY

why_choose_us.h2: Why Tompkins County homeowners trust Upscale

items.title: A fixed price before construction
items.text: Free pricing guides show typical starting costs, running estimates follow you through design, and the price is fixed before any building starts. Reviewers describe no surprises on cost.

items.title: Five years of coverage
items.text: Every project carries a 5-year warranty, and the process ends with post-completion support and anniversary inspections, so someone comes back to check the work after you move back in.

items.title: A+ BBB, zero complaints
items.text: Upscale is accredited by the Better Business Bureau with an A+ rating and reports zero complaints in more than 30 years of service. It was also named to Remodeling magazine's Top 550 list.

items.title: Certified people on your job
items.text: Designer Christie holds the CKBD and CLIPP credentials and is president of the NKBA Central New York chapter. The firm is a Certified Graduate Remodeler, an Aging-in-Place Specialist and EPA Lead-Safe certified.

about.h2: Steve Nash and a family of Ithaca builders
about.text: Founder Steve Nash's ancestors settled the Ellis Hollow and Snyder Hill area in the early 1800s and built some of the region's first homes, and several still stand. Steve started learning the trade at age nine, working beside his father and grandfather. The lesson he kept was simple: never compromise and never cut corners. He founded Upscale Remodeling, and the company has served Ithaca since 1991. Today he leads a team that includes designer Christie, project manager Rich, lead carpenters Caesar and Ken, and estimator Scott, with ongoing training for every role.

image.alt: Steve Nash, founder of Upscale Remodeling in Freeville and Ithaca, NY

steps.title: Discovery and getting acquainted
steps.text: An initial call, then a free meeting and site visit at your home. If it is a fit, you sign a Project Development Agreement to start design.

steps.title: Design and development
steps.text: Conceptual design, design development and selections in the Freeville Design Studio, with running estimates, ending in a final design and formal fixed-price proposal.

steps.title: Construction
steps.text: Permits, material ordering, scheduling and a pre-construction meeting come first. During the build you get constant communication from your project manager.

steps.title: Completion and enjoyment
steps.text: A final walk-through, then the 5-year warranty period with post-completion support and anniversary inspections.

service_area.h2: Greater Ithaca, from Lansing to Trumansburg
service_area.text: The office and Design Studio sit at 1410 Dryden Road in Freeville and are open by appointment. Upscale's projects reach across Ithaca, including Cayuga Heights, Fall Creek, East Hill, South Hill, West Hill and Ellis Hollow, and out to Lansing, Trumansburg, Newfield, Interlaken and the Town of Hector. If you live elsewhere in the Finger Lakes, call to ask.

items.q: How much does a kitchen remodel cost in Ithaca?
items.a: Upscale says most kitchen remodels it completes in the Ithaca area start at $70,000, and most bathrooms start at $40,000. Free pricing guides on its site break down each level. Because every kitchen is custom, you get running estimates during design and a fixed price before construction begins.

items.q: How long will my kitchen be out of service?
items.a: Most kitchen remodels in the greater Ithaca area are finished within eight to fourteen weeks from the start of construction, depending on scope. When a project also takes in a pantry, laundry area or breakfast nook, those parts are scheduled in parallel to shorten the time without a kitchen.

items.q: My house is old. Will that cause surprises?
items.a: Plaster walls, aging plumbing, knob-and-tube wiring and beams in unexpected places are common in Ithaca and Finger Lakes homes. Upscale assesses those conditions early, before design decisions are locked in, so the scope and price reflect what is actually behind the walls.

items.q: What does the warranty cover after the job?
items.a: Upscale backs its work with a 5-year warranty, which it calls industry-leading. The final phase of its process includes a warranty period with post-completion support and anniversary inspections. One reviewer noted the crew came back to adjust cabinets and fix small problems without hesitation.

Yes. Upscale will schedule an initial consultation at no cost, walk through your space, talk about what is realistic for your budget and explain the process from start to finish. Product selections later happen in the private Design Studio in Freeville, which is open by appointment.
